+        ("example.com", "http://myexample.com", False),
+        ("example.com", "http://example.com:8080", True),
+        ("example.com", "http://sub.example.com:8080", True),
+        ("example.com", "http://myexample.com:8080", False),
+    ]
+    
+    for no_proxy, url, expected in test_cases:
+        result = should_bypass_proxies(url, no_proxy=no_proxy)

+    test_no_proxy_behavior()
